title: Subproperty closure — RDFS5 transitive subPropertyOf
description: If P ⊑ Q and Q ⊑ R, the reasoner derives P ⊑ R. Combined with capability 30-property-characteristics, this means every P(x,y) fact also implies R(x,y). The default KB declares hasMother ⊑ hasParent ⊑ hasAncestor and an asserted hasMother fact — you should see hasParent and hasAncestor inferred.
